title: rollback-site-profile command payload

decidedBy.description: The deciding platform admin's oid, written to SiteProfileVersions.AppliedBy; absent = system:worker.

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of the command rollback-site-profile (connectors design §5.6): applies an earlier version of the site profile again. Dedup site-profile:{siteProfileId}.
